info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trade Reporting API
info.description: The Trade Reporting API enables financial institutions to submit trade data for regulatory compliance and reporting purposes. This endpoint facilitates the creation of detailed reports on market operations, allowing users to manage and oversee their trading activities. Ideal for compliance officers and trade operations teams, this API helps ensure transparency and adherence to industry regulations. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can efficiently streamline their reporting processes and enhance their data accuracy.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to generate a new trade report based on the provided data. Ensure that all required fields are correctly filled to successfully create the report.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating a new trade reporting report. It should contain all necessary details of the trade operations being reported in JSON format.
